title: Fantastic pillow! Best I have ever used.
text: Fantastic pillow! Best I have ever used.. I absolutely love this pillow. I have suffered from neck and shoulder pain for most of my life and have tried all kinds of pillows to aid in my sleep. This inflatable cervical adjustable pillow is fantastic. With a touch of a button I can adjust the volume and get the optimum sleep support that I need. Material is super soft and cushiony but it gives me the support I need. I wish it wasn't made in China (prefer to buy American) but this pillow is definitely one of the best I have ever tried.

product_metadata.title: RESTCLOUD Cervical Neck Pillow for Sleeping, Neck Roll Pillow Memory Foam Pillow Neck Bolster Pillow for Neck Pain Relief Height and Firm Adjustable
features: Adjustable Cervical Neck Traction Pillow: TPU air pump and memory foam layer inside the pillow to adjust to the height you needs and wants. Your neck will feel a large strength of cervical traction with comfortable feeling. Attention: this version doesn’t have electric heat and vibrating function.

Stretch Cervical Spine 30 min a day: easily adjust the size and fatigue of the pillow while lying down by simply inflating or deflating it. When inflating, it is a neck stretcher. Helps to restore issues associated with stiff neck, straight neck, military neck and forward head posture.
Neck Support all night: cervical pillow provides a proper height for neck keeping a healthy curvature all night by simply deflating all air, relief the neck pain.

This Chiropractic Roll Pillow is gently and naturally stretches your neck in order to help decompress your spine, increase blood flow, circulation, and stretch your muscles while helping to align the cervical curve.

High Quality Materials: Memory foam is ROHS Certified without 169 chemicals. The Medical grade TPU Air bag hold the air all night. The pure cotton pillowcase is skin friendly, soft and breathable. If there is a light smell, please remove the pillowcase and air out 1-2 days, the smell will be gone.
Please check if the air pump was installed tightly and totally near the inflate and deflate button before use.
